prompt: Challenge C144-CH2: Downstream purification — specifically the ultrafiltration step — runs at only 55% of nominal throughput because the membranes foul with res

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Fouling mechanisms in polymeric membranes during food processing can be characterized through systematic variation of operating parameters such as crossflow velocity and transmembrane pressure, and fouling layer composition varies with feed pH.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08240","field":"abstract","quote":"Fouling indices including the modified fouling index were evaluated under systematically varied crossflow velocities and transmembrane pressures"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08242","field":"abstract","quote":"systematically evaluates the influence of feed pH on fouling layer composition, membrane flux, and rejection"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Pre-screening of feed streams through mesh and tangential flow microfiltration pre-treatment can reduce fouling in downstream membrane separation, with pre-screening reducing total fouling resistance by 34%.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08240","field":"abstract","quote":"Pre-screening of the feed stream through a 200 µm mesh reduced total fouling resistance by 34%"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08244","field":"abstract","quote":"Fouling of the microporous polypropylene membranes by biomass and protein residues was characterised and substantially mitigated by inclusion of a tangential flow microfiltration pre-treatment step"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Research on residual biomass and protein fouling in membrane systems has demonstrated that filtration pre-treatment stages enable cost reduction in lactic acid recovery from fermentation broths, with the integrated process reducing operating costs by approximately 30% relative to conventional routes.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08244","field":"abstract","quote":"Fouling of the microporous polypropylene membranes by biomass and protein residues was characterised and substantially mitigated"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08244","field":"abstract","quote":"the integrated process reduces operating costs by approximately 30% relative to a conventional ion-exchange recovery route"}]}]}
